_comment: 本仓依赖的宿主触点快照。由 scripts/gen-host-snapshot.mjs 从 cordis_inspect_query 的结果整理；升级后重跑它对比。

skills.description: Layered registry of skill providers（plugin-kit 的 Host 半用它注册 skill）

methods.get: async get(name: string, options: SkillViewOptions = {}): Promise<SkillDefinition | undefined>

tools.description: Concrete tool registry and scoped executor dispatcher.

methods.get: get(name: string, scope?: ScopeKey, toolSet?: ResolvedToolSet): ToolDefinition | undefined
methods.definitions: definitions(scope?: ScopeKey, toolSet?: ResolvedToolSet): readonly ToolDefinition[]

methods.announce: async announce(agent: Agent, source: SessionStartSource, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void>

agent/created.signature: 'agent/created'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; source: SessionStartSource; signal?: AbortSignal }): undefined | Promise<undefined>

configs._comment: 本插件不导出 Config；此处仅留空占位，保持结构与 sample 一致。
